newsitem.title: USA: U.S. states reach deal with tobacco companies.
newsitem.headline: U.S. states reach deal with tobacco companies.

text.p: U.S. states reached a tentative agreement with cigarette companies on Friday to settle many of the lawsuits against the industry and to fund major new anti-smoking efforts, a lawyer for the states and a negotiator told reporters.
"Everything looks good," said Trey Bobinger, an aide to the chief negotiator for U.S. states, Mississippi Attorney General Mike Moore. "There appears to be a deal."
